tasks.label: Workspace: validate
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $failed = $false; foreach ($file in @('.\WMT-GUI.ps1', '.\PS2EXE\Build-Exe.ps1', '.\tools\diagnostics\Measure-WmtResources.ps1')) { if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing expected PowerShell file: $file" }; $tokens = $null; $parseErrors = $null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $file).Path, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors); if ($parseErrors.Count -gt 0) { $failed = $true; foreach ($err in $parseErrors) { Write-Host ('{0}:{1}:{2}: {3}' -f $file, $err.Extent.StartLineNumber, $err.Extent.StartColumnNumber, $err.Message) } } else { Write-Host "OK: $file" } }; if ($failed) { exit 1 }
